title: Yokohama Kaidashi Kikou
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Long after an unexplained environmental disaster has raised the seas and the human population is quietly dwindling, the cheerful robot Alpha runs a small coffee shop on the Miura Peninsula while waiting for her absent owner. Mostly self-contained chapters follow her brewing coffee, riding her scooter to Yokohama for supplies, taking photographs and visiting neighbors, as children grow up and the coastline slowly changes.
life_message: It holds up savoring small, everyday moments and accepting that all things pass.
